_note: USD list prices used to estimate cost from reported usage. Perplexity reports exact cost per request, so it isn't listed. Each engine is a list of price periods; the latest `from` date on or before the run date applies. Free allowances (e.g. Gemini's 5,000 free searches a month) are NOT subtracted, so estimates are an upper bound.

chatgpt.source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, checked 2026-11-06 (web search: reasoning models incl. gpt-5)

gemini.source: aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, checked 2026-11-06 (paid tier; thinking billed as output; 5,000 free searches/month not subtracted)
